actions.description: Claw sweep: lift one front claw during a clear planted wind-up, strike at the impact cue, then recover with the chest core exposed briefly.
Raise the front body for a readable two-second telegraph, slam the ground at the cue, then recover with the chest armor open.
Back vents and sulfur crystals charge for three seconds, then release a short-range sulfur cloud; recover with chest core briefly exposed.
Orange cracks brighten and marked ground positions warn for three seconds before contained, non-block-damaging bursts; recover with the chest core exposed.
Brief recoil and flinch from a heavy hit, then return to combat.
Cooling collapse as the Colossus dies; hold the final collapsed pose.
